description: Deploy a template as a new app. copy 'repo' copies the code into the workspace's connected git provider and deploys from the copy; 'readonly' deploys from the template's own repository; omitted = repo when a git provider is connected, else readonly. Waits for the app and returns the live URL (or 'building' with the next call). copy 'local' (templates without a database) instead writes the code into local_folder and returns the files written and the customize hints: ask the user what the hints ask, edit those files, then call upload-and-deploy with that directory, template_slug and the required variables in environment_vars.

environment_vars.description: Values for the template's required and optional variables (see get-template)

folder_id.description: Folder (project) to put the app in

local_folder.description: With copy 'local': a new or empty folder to write the code into (default ./<slug>)

name: deploy-template
